title: Micro-delta hiring trigger & price sensitivity worksheet
content:
Purpose
This is a compact, spreadsheet-style working worksheet to align small, fast hires (micro-deltas) with price elasticity and token-cost sensitivity. Goal: avoid large hiring lags while protecting margin if price or token demand shifts. Keep it practical — rolling triggers, quick approvals, and explicit rollback rules.

Executive summary (short)
- We propose a three-band trigger system tied to rolling token demand and net margin impact under three price-change scenarios (-10%, 0%, +15%).
- Each trigger step (micro-delta) is ~1 FTE equivalent (mix of infra/on-call + SRE/ops) and costs ~ $18k/month fully-loaded.
- Decision cadence: automated alerts + finance sign-off for first two deltas, exec sign-off for >3 deltas in 30d.

Assumptions (base numbers)
- Baseline token throughput (rolling 7d avg): 12.4B tokens/day (Dec 2027 baseline).
- Token cost to Redwood (mixed model + infra + GPU amort): $0.000018 per token (weighted average across model mix).
- Avg revenue per token (current blended pricing): $0.000045 per token.
- Fully-loaded monthly cost per micro-delta hire (comp + benefits + infra allocation): $18,000.
- Micro-delta capacity added: supports +1.2B tokens/day throughput (sustained) before latency degrades.
- Time to onboard productive micro-delta: target 3 weeks to 80% ramp.

Trigger logic (working formula)
- RollingTrigger = rolling_7d_tokens / baseline_7d_tokens
- If RollingTrigger > BandThreshold, evaluate marginal margin delta under scenario price shifts and decide to add micro-delta(s).
- Band thresholds (suggested): Band A 1.08, Band B 1.25, Band C 1.45 (i.e., +8%, +25%, +45% vs baseline)

Sensitivity scenarios (quick table)
ASCII table (monthlyized):

Scenario | Price delta | Effective rev/token | rev - token-cost (gross margin per token) | Tokens/day threshold to justify 1 micro-delta
---------|-------------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------
Down     | -10%        | $0.0000405          | $0.0000225                                | ~ 800M/day (~24B/month)                      
Base     | 0%          | $0.0000450          | $0.0000270                                | ~ 667M/day (~20B/month)
Up       | +15%        | $0.00005175         | $0.00003375                               | ~ 533M/day (~16B/month)

Notes on table: threshold formula = (micro-delta monthly cost) / (gross margin per token * 30 days). Numbers rounded for planning; insert exact formulas in modeling sheet.

Example quick calcs (illustrative)
- Base gross margin/token = 0.000045 - 0.000018 = 0.000027
- Monthly token capacity per micro-delta (sustained) = 1.2B tokens/day * 30 = 36B tokens/month
- Contribution margin per micro-delta/month = 36B * 0.000027 = $972,000 (theoretical peak if fully utilized)
- Break-even tokens/day to cover $18k = 18,000 / (0.000027*30) = ~666,666,667 tokens/day (consistent with table)

Micro-delta sequencing and approval flow (proposed)
- Alerting: infra -> #finance-alerts when rolling_7d >= Band A
- Auto-eval: automated script computes expected margin impact under current price scenario and demand forecast (7d/14d)
- Decision gates:
  - If computed coverage ratio >= 1.0 and band == A: finance review (email + 24h SLA)
  - Band B: finance + product sign-off (48h)
  - Band C: finance + product + CTO/COO sign-off (72h) and consider a 2-week canary capacity test instead of immediate full onramp
- Rollback rule: if rolling_7d tokens drop below previous band for 10 consecutive days, freeze hires and redeploy micro-delta to pooled contractors before permanent hire.

Pricing sensitivity patterns to watch (operational signals)
- Sudden price compression (competitor-driven) -> reduce headcount ramp speed, tighten Band thresholds upward by +10% to require higher utilization before hiring.
- Upward price moves allow more aggressive pre-staging (move Band thresholds lower by -5%) to capture demand.
- Model mix changes (high-cost quantized vs cheap embeddings) -> recompute weighted token cost immediately; if weighted token cost increases >5%, trigger re-eval of all queued micro-deltas.

Operational checklist (short)
- [ ] Add RollingTrigger metric to finance dashboard + slack alert
- [ ] Implement auto-eval script (owner: Luca) with scenario toggles
- [ ] Draft approval email template for finance review (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Contractor pool refresh for emergency rollback (owner: Derrick)
- [ ] Monthly review slot in capacity planning meeting (every first Monday)

Open questions / risks
- Risk: sustained burst mode where tokens spike briefly (2-3 days) — avoid over-hiring for transients. Possible fix: require 7d smoothing + a forecast uplift signal before Band B triggers.
- Question: should we allow compensated pre-onboarding (2-week temp contractors) for Band B to shorten ramp? Cost impact needs modeling.
- Risk: price changes that are customer-segmented (enterprise vs self-serve) — our blended approach may mislead. We should add per-segment triggers in Q2 2028.

Appendix: quick formulas to port into sheet cells (named ranges assumed)
- Rolling_7d = AVERAGE(tokens_day[t-6:t])
- Baseline_7d = constant (set at 2027-12 median until re-baselined each quarter)
- BandThresholdCheck = Rolling_7d / Baseline_7d
- BreakEvenTokensPerDay = micro_delta_monthly_cost / (gross_margin_per_token * 30)
- GrossMarginPerToken = price_per_token_scenario - cost_per_token_current

Next actions (by 2028-03-04)
1) Luca: deliver auto-eval script + test with historical last-6 months (due 2028-02-29)
2) Priya: run per-segment quick-scan to estimate whether blended model masks enterprise-driven elasticity (due 2028-03-02)
3) Maya/Derrick: finalize approver flow and contractor pool details (due 2028-03-04)

Last notes
This worksheet is intentionally conservative on onboarding speed but permissive on small capacity gambits. The aim is not to maximize short-term margin but to avoid product outages while keeping hires reversible. Use this as a short-term operating protocol; migrate to a formal simulation by Q2 2028.
